This simple mushroom packed skewer has its colorful presentation to thank for its appeal.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Mushroom Skewers are [[Meal]]s that can be made by [[Cooking]] any [[Mushroom]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]. In order to cook the regular version of this dish, [[Link]] must use either only [[Hylian Shroom]]s or multiple, different Mushrooms with varying effects. If Link consumes a Mushroom Skewer it will restore at least one of his [[Heart]]s. The skewers are known for their colorful presentation. Using certain Mushrooms when making Mushroom Skewers can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
This simple mushroom-packed skewer has its colorful presentation to thank for its appeal.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Chillshroom]]s. They can be eaten to grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
This simple mushroom-packed skewer has its colorful presentation to thank for its appeal.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Zapshroom]]s. Eating them will give Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Mushroom Skewer}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This simple mushroom-packed skewer has its colorful presentation to thank for its appeal.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Shroom]]s. Link can eat them to completely refill and overfill his [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Mushroom Skewer}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
This simple mushroom-packed skewer has its colorful presentation to thank for its appeal.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stamella Shroom]]s. By eating them, a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel will be refilled. * '''Hasty Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This simple mushroom-packed skewer has its colorful presentation to thank for its appeal.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Rushroom]]s. When eaten, they will increase Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Mushroom Skewer}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This simple mushroom-packed skewer has its colorful presentation to thank for its appeal.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Truffle]]s or [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s. Eating these skewers will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Mighty Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This simple mushroom-packed skewer has its colorful presentation to thank for its appeal.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Razorshroom]]s. If these skewers are eaten, Link will gain a boost to his attack power. * '''Sneaky Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
This simple mushroom-packed skewer has its colorful presentation to thank for its appeal.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Silent Shroom]]s. Link's [[Stealth]] abilities will be increased by eating them. * '''Spicy Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
This simple mushroom-packed skewer has its colorful presentation to thank for its appeal.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sunshroom]]s. Consuming these skewers will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Mushroom Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Mushroom Skewer}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This simple mushroom-packed skewer has its colorful presentation to thank for its appeal.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Ironshroom]]s. Link gains a boost to his [[Defense]] when he eats them. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Only one variation of Mushroom Skewer, the Electro Mushroom Skewer, is found in {{AoC}}, and its recipe is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Who's Shocked by Lightning?]]". It is made using four [[Zapshroom]]s. However, it can be lowered to three through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". Preparing this meal before a battle reduces the damage the [[Warrior]]s take from [[Lightning]] attacks by 50%. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Electro Mushroom Skewer Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Electro Mushroom Skewer icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Copious Mushroom Skewers * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Skewers |items= BotW, TotK }}
